verdict.call: Confirmed: the platinum pops when the other 54 are earned. The official list and every guide agree on this — there is nothing to dispute.
verdict.note: All 55 trophies are offline and single-player, so no online or DLC trophy can block it.

trophies.lastChance: Pops with the 54th trophy — nothing to miss.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist, which opens under Progress, Stats after the credits. It is closer to 60% of true completion — most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required.

steps.text: Finish the story first — the checklist stays hidden until the credits roll.
Work the checklist: every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's Target Decks and 70 of the 80 challenges.
Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals along the way — both count toward 100%.
Finish 15 of the 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations and 100 Cocaine Flamingos.

a.text: About 200 hours to the platinum, difficulty 4/10.

b.text: 200 to 250 hours or more, up to 300 hours or more; difficulty 7/10 in some guides.

verdict.call: Budget 200 hours as the floor and 250+ as the plan. The hours are the dispute — the checklist is not: every item on it is listed in the guides, and it only opens after the credits.
verdict.note: Every guide names A Long Road the hardest trophy; they disagree only on how long it takes.

trophies.safePlay: Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — 15 manual slots plus one autosave — and never touch a cheat: cheats disable trophies and saving.
trophies.lastChance: Safe after the credits — the checklist only opens then, and everything on it stays available.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 meditations at 10 spots. Most spots take two meditations — one as Jason, one as Lucia — plus the Chapter 1 balcony (Lucia) and the Ascent spot. The balcony is the one possibly missable step in the whole game.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; follow her to the balcony and meditate there — the one meditation that may be missable.
Meditate at the Ascent spot — 1 meditation.
Meditate at the other 8 spots with BOTH Jason and Lucia — 2 meditations per spot, 16 in total.
Check the maths: balcony 1 + Ascent 1 + 8 spots × 2 = 18 meditations at 10 spots. The last spots need both characters, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

a.text: 18 meditations at 10 spots; the Chapter 1 balcony meditation counts and may be required.

b.text: Some pre-release guides count 15 meditations, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether the balcony meditation is actually required.

verdict.call: Play it as 18 with the balcony done in Chapter 1 — the safe count. If the real total is 15, doing 18 still pops the trophy; skipping the balcony risks the one missable in the game.
verdict.note: The count dispute is exactly why the safe play below exists: do the balcony first, count to 18, and the dispute stops mattering.

trophies.safePlay: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1, before the mission Down to Earth. After that mission, go to Jason's house in the morning, follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate. Do NOT leave Chapter 1 without that meditation — there is no mission replay, and it is the only step in the game the guides flag as possibly missable.
trophies.lastChance: Chapter 1 — the balcony meditation, before leaving Chapter 1. The other 9 spots stay open after Chapter 1.
